scope.mission: Fix the existing BREACH-V2 implementation without rebuilding it.
inScope: physical apertures, portals, corridors, room shells and ceilings
collision, navigation, player-capsule clearance, WASD and click-to-move
fresh visual, real-GPU, automated and independent-verifier evidence
outOfScope: rebuild or replace the authored flat map without a proven measured defect
character or monster production owned by issue 448
merge, deploy, release or replacement of current Level 01

requirements.description: Both selectable routes preserve the authored fixed spine, 3-5 legal gallery chambers, convergence and boss suite.
Every required edge has source aperture, seated portal, continuous corridor and destination aperture.
Ashen Lock, First Memory Vault, Way Upward and Heartvale form the authored sequential physical connection.
Door/gate animation, collision, nav and player-capsule clearance remain synchronized.
WASD and click-to-move traverse the same complete route without survey warps.
Tutorial, route choice, galleries, Warden, First Memory once, exit and save/reload form one complete run.
Real-time default and turn-based smoke use the same authoritative simulation and outcomes.
Every room and threshold passes wide, close, both-side, shell, ceiling, material, lighting and orientation review.
Typecheck, tests, build, release verification, real-GPU renderer and performance gates pass on the current commit.

expectedMatrices: both routes and representative sparse/median/dense seeds
every fixed room and selected pooled room
